description:
Property Summary
A most impressive two storey detached residence comes to the market in pristine condition in a beautiful setting with fabulous mature gardens overlooking Wexford town & Harbour. The spacious and light filled accommodation is evident throughout, from the homely kitchen/diner
overlooking the gardens, a cosy sitting room to the front with a very bright and airy living room also includes 4 bedrooms, 1 studio bedroom, 3 ensuites and 2 bathrooms. The feeling of space continues both in the very inviting entrance hallway which flows seamlessly through to the outside with an enclosed rear garden where the outdoor space becomes another ideal entertaining area - perfect for summer time bbq's or an early morning coffee. For those of you looking for outdoor space in a highly convenient location, this home certainly caters for those requirements. This property is presented in excellent condition boasting both tiled and wooden flooring, a beautifully fitted kitchen and is ready for any new home owner to move in and make it their own. It has the most homely and welcoming atmosphere from the moment you enter the hall door. The property also features a spacious detached garage which offers excellent potential for many uses. Location is supreme also, and is ideally positioned being approx. 2km to the town centre as well as schools, supermarkets, sporting facilities etc! . Other attractions locally include a host of beaches, Carrigfoyle Quarry, Johnstown Castle, Min Ryan Park, to name but a few!  For those needing to commute further field there is easy access to the N25 & N/M11. The sale of this property offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a fabulous spacious home in an accessible location and is not to be missed ! Properties in this location are rare to hit the market.  VIEWING HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
